description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - Notify the Wages Board for the Retail and Wholesale Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the approval and implementation of decisions made by the Wages Board for the Retail and Wholesale Trade under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving labor regulations and wage determinations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
